introduction_transcription.expected: A published bright-end summary can lack a reconstructible object record because the data are missing, or because the search missed them. If the underlying object rows were genuinely absent from public archives, that would limit independent reconstruction of the bright end. But an apparent archival gap could instead be a fact about case-sensitive names, metadata tags, or unrecognized column aliases. How do we tell missing data from missed data?
